title: Course-average GPA rows use NULL in the conflict key, so repeated enrichment can accumulate stale aggregate rows

evidence.quote:
INSERT INTO gpa_stats (subject, number, instructor, avg_gpa, median_gpa, sample_size, last_updated)
SELECT
  subject,
  number,
  NULL as instructor,
...
ON CONFLICT(subject, number, instructor) DO UPDATE SET

FROM gpa_stats g
LEFT JOIN courses c ON g.subject = c.subject AND g.number = c.number
WHERE g.instructor IS NULL

reasoning: D1/SQLite UNIQUE conflict handling does not treat NULL values as equal, so inserting course-average rows with instructor = NULL will not reliably hit ON CONFLICT(subject, number, instructor). Re-running enrichCoursesWithGpa can create multiple NULL-instructor aggregate rows for the same course. The follow-up SELECT reads all NULL aggregate rows, which can produce repeated or stale course updates with nondeterministic final values.
reproduction: Run enrichCoursesWithGpa twice for the same subject/number with instructor-level gpa_stats present. Each run can insert another instructor NULL aggregate row instead of updating the previous aggregate row.
recommendation: Do not rely on NULL in the conflict key. Use a non-null sentinel for course averages, add a generated/coalesced unique key, or explicitly delete/update existing NULL aggregate rows for each subject/number before inserting the new aggregate.
whyTestsDoNotAlreadyCoverThis: The included enrichment tests import coordinateEnrichment and enrichCoursesWithScores, but do not call enrichCoursesWithGpa or assert idempotency of NULL-instructor aggregate rows.
suggestedRegressionTest: Use a real D1/SQLite test or faithful fake to run enrichCoursesWithGpa twice, then assert exactly one course-average row exists per subject/number and courses receives the latest aggregate once.
minimumFixScope: apps/api/src/services/enrichment.ts and possibly the gpa_stats uniqueness strategy.
